title: Design Patterns: Elements of Reusable Object-Oriented Software
author: Erich Gamma, Richard Helm, Ralph Johnson, John Vlissides (GoF)
subject: Software Architecture
preferredExchange: Clean Architecture by Robert Martin or Head First Design Patterns
description: The classic Gang of Four handbook on creational, structural, and behavioral software design patterns.

title: Operating System Concepts (Dinosaur Book)
author: Abraham Silberschatz, Peter B. Galvin, Greg Gagne
subject: Operating Systems
preferredExchange: Computer Networking: A Top-Down Approach or Microprocessor 8085
description: Classic OS bible. Comprehensive explanations of process scheduling, virtual memory, paging, and deadlocks.

title: Theory of Computation: Formal Languages and Automata
author: Michael Sipser
subject: Theory of Computation
preferredExchange: Compiler Design by Aho or Discrete Mathematics by Rosen
description: Pristine copy of Sipser. Automata theory, Turing machines, decidability, and computational complexity (P vs NP).

title: Computer Networks: A Systems Approach
author: Larry L. Peterson, Bruce S. Davie
subject: Computer Networks
description: Clear protocol-oriented approach from physical layer to application layer. Thorough coverage of TCP/IP.

title: Let Us C
author: Yashavant Kanetkar
subject: Programming in C
description: Classic introductory C programming textbook for 1st year engineering undergraduates. All basic programs tested.

title: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach
author: Stuart Russell, Peter Norvig
subject: Artificial Intelligence
preferredExchange: Deep Learning by Goodfellow or Pattern Recognition by Bishop
description: Definitive guide to modern AI. Includes intelligent agents, search algorithms, logic, and planning.

title: Clean Code: A Handbook of Agile Software Craftsmanship
author: Robert C. Martin (Uncle Bob)
subject: Software Engineering
description: Must-read programming book on writing readable, testable, maintainable code. No markings, like brand new.

title: Pattern Recognition and Machine Learning
author: Christopher M. Bishop
subject: Machine Learning
preferredExchange: Artificial Intelligence by Russell & Norvig or Reinforcement Learning by Sutton
description: In-depth Bayesian machine learning reference. Immaculate condition with hardcover.

title: Discrete Mathematics and Its Applications
author: Kenneth H. Rosen
subject: Discrete Mathematics
preferredExchange: Higher Engineering Mathematics by B.S. Grewal or Data Structures by Lipschutz
description: Comprehensive discrete structures text: propositional logic, proofs, set theory, combinatorics, graph theory.

title: Java: The Complete Reference
author: Herbert Schildt
subject: Object Oriented Programming
preferredExchange: Effective Java by Joshua Bloch or Design Patterns (GoF)
description: Comprehensive manual covering core Java syntax, OOP, Collections, Multithreading, and I/O streams.

title: Cell and Molecular Biology: Concepts and Experiments
author: Gerald Karp
subject: Biotechnology
description: Detailed biotechnology guide: membrane structure, bioenergetics, cellular communication, and genetics.

title: Signals and Systems
author: Alan V. Oppenheim, Alan S. Willsky, S. Hamid Nawab
subject: Signals and Systems
description: The classic signal processing textbook. Continuous-time and discrete-time signals, Fourier analysis, Laplace & Z-transforms.

title: Basic Structural Analysis
author: C.S. Reddy
subject: Civil Engineering
description: Fundamental structural mechanics, deflection analysis, moment distribution method, and influence lines.

title: Introduction to Algorithms (CLRS)
author: Thomas H. Cormen, Charles E. Leiserson, Ronald L. Rivest
subject: Data Structures and Algorithms
preferredExchange: Operating System Concepts by Silberschatz or Computer Networks by Tanenbaum
description: Essential textbook for algorithms and data structures. Minimal pencil markings on greedy algorithms chapter, binding rock solid.

title: Computer Organization and Architecture
author: William Stallings
subject: Computer Architecture
preferredExchange: Microprocessor Architecture by Gaonkar or Modern Operating Systems
description: Clean walkthrough of CPU cache hierarchy, instruction sets, pipelining, RISC vs CISC, and parallel processing.

title: Deep Learning
author: Ian Goodfellow, Yoshua Bengio, Aaron Courville
subject: Deep Learning
preferredExchange: Pattern Recognition and ML by Bishop or Computer Vision by Szeliski
description: The deep learning textbook. Deep feedforward networks, regularization, optimization, CNNs, RNNs, and autoencoders.

title: Database System Concepts
author: Abraham Silberschatz, Henry F. Korth, S. Sudarshan
subject: Database Management Systems
description: Standard textbook for DBMS covering relational model, SQL, indexing, and transactions. Zero pen marks.

title: Software Engineering: A Practitioner's Approach
author: Roger S. Pressman, Bruce R. Maxim
subject: Software Engineering
description: Agile processes, UML modeling, software testing, maintenance, and project metrics. Some annotations inside.

title: Engineering Physics
author: H.K. Malik, A.K. Singh
subject: Engineering Physics
description: Covers optics, laser physics, quantum mechanics fundamentals, ultrasonics, and crystallography for 1st years.

title: Higher Engineering Mathematics
author: Dr. B.S. Grewal
subject: Engineering Mathematics
description: Standard university math textbook covering calculus, differential equations, Laplace transforms, and linear algebra.

title: Microprocessor Architecture, Programming and Applications with 8085
author: Ramesh S. Gaonkar
subject: Microprocessors
description: Covers 8085 pin diagram, assembly language programming, timing diagrams, memory interfacing, and interrupts.

title: Digital Logic and Computer Design
author: M. Morris Mano
subject: Digital Electronics
preferredExchange: Signals and Systems by Oppenheim or Microelectronic Circuits
description: Foundational digital logic book. Boolean algebra, logic gates, combinational and sequential circuit design.

title: Internal Combustion Engines
author: V. Ganesan
subject: Mechanical Engineering
description: Standard textbook for thermodynamics of IC engines, fuel injection, air pollution, and dual combustion cycles.

title: Compilers: Principles, Techniques, and Tools (Dragon Book)
author: Alfred V. Aho, Monica S. Lam, Ravi Sethi, Jeffrey D. Ullman
subject: Compiler Design
description: The legendary Dragon book on compiler construction: lexical analysis, syntax-directed translation, code optimization.
